records.title: Where Animacy Lives in Large Language Models: Tracing the Circuits of the Animacy Concept
records.reason: The paper analyzes animacy circuits with controlled prompts and ablations; its findings concern interpretability/generalization, not serving cost.

records.title: AdaKP: Online Adaptive Knowledge-Point Selection for Reasoning-Oriented Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: AdaKP reduces knowledge-point selection overhead during RL training; its main trained-model comparison uses no hints at inference, outside this inference-efficiency target.

records.title: Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning for Enhancing Robustness of Large Vision Language Model
records.reason: The method is adversarial robustness fine-tuning for LVLMs; tested improvements are robustness/accuracy, not inference cost.

records.title: ResearchArena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in Automated AI R&D
records.reason: Inference-server optimization appears as a safety-benchmark task; the paper evaluates sabotage/monitor detection, not a serving optimization.

records.title: InternReviewer&InternAdvocate: Objective Reward and Evaluation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Peer Review and Rebuttal
records.reason: The paper’s infrastructure gains serve peer-review agent training/evaluation rollouts, not LLM decoding or inference serving.
